body.name: formula-or-global-twin certificate
body.construction: A positive certificate is \(\kappa_H=(F_H,\mathcal D_H^{\mathrm{den}},\mathfrak D_H)\), including the reduced circuit, its complete denominator registry, and its positive semialgebraic execution domain. A negative certificate is \(\kappa_H=\{b\mapsto(\theta_b^{+},\theta_b^{-}):b\in\mathcal B_H\}\), encoded by rational response tables and latent-root probabilities together with expanded polynomial identities for observed-law equality, strict inequalities for admissible-cell positivity, exact support \(H\), and a nonzero target contrast.
